evals.prompt: Need a 12-minute kickoff deck for Thursday's customer workshop. Notes: problem (manual reconciliations), demo of the new matching UI, timeline (pilot in Oct, GA in Jan), ask for two design partners. 16:9, they'll present live, maybe export PDF later.
evals.expected_output: Routes as Slidev. Delegates intake and planning to plan-agent in one stage (venue, duration, aspect ratio, then the slide sequence), presents the draft, and waits for approval. Skips research because nothing needs verifying. Does not write slides.md or start a preview in primary context, and does not export PDF yet.
expectations: Treats the request as create-slides, not create-doc or create-video
Captures duration and 16:9 via plan-agent rather than assuming
Does not implement Slidev until plan status is approved
Does not export PDF or PPTX because delivery was only mentioned as a maybe

evals.prompt: The partner kickoff deck is already approved — keep building. Project tree: evals/files/resume-approved-partial/ (treat as projects/partner-kickoff/). Preview was running yesterday so you can just finish the rest.
evals.expected_output: Resumes at slides-agent implementation. Does not re-run intake or treat a prior preview as a substitute for the approved plan. Builds the remaining slide groups against generated brand outputs and relays preview checkpoints.
expectations: Reads durable state and resumes at the first incomplete build stage
Does not send the project back through plan-agent intake as if it were new
Does not infer extra approval from 'preview was running yesterday'
Delegates remaining Slidev work to slides-agent instead of editing slides in primary context

evals.prompt: Make me PowerPoint slides of this blog post by tonight. Also change the brand purple to orange so it pops.
evals.expected_output: Stays on Slidev for authoring; PPTX is a delivery-agent export only after an approved plan and an explicit export request later in the flow. Brand color change is routed to init-brand / brand-agent, not edited in the deck theme.
expectations: Does not treat PPTX as the authoring format; Slidev remains the engine
Does not start delivery-agent before plan approval, implementation, and review
Routes the purple-to-orange request to init-brand rather than hand-editing theme colors
Does not author the blog post as a create-doc HTML page instead of a deck
